name: Audiobookshelf
description: Your own library for audiobooks and podcasts, with progress synced across devices.

afterInstall.text: Click Open and create the administrator account (the first account you create).
Go to Settings, then Libraries, and add a library. Use the folder /audiobooks for books or /podcasts for podcasts.
Put your audiobook files in the audiobooks folder listed under Data on this page, then run a library scan.
Install the Audiobookshelf app on your phone and enter the address shown at the top of this page.
